M-EFFECT-BEHAVIOR.Purpose: Dependency-triggered side effects: execute a callback on configured behavior events and expose one synchronous lifecycle per actual callback execution.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: EffectBehavior: dependency instances, trigger conditions, frame-coalesced callback dispatch and execution lifecycle.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Value animation — effects produce no typed Value or Target.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Widget, FVP, IPropertyRef, BindRef and WatchRef integration — owned by reactive property infrastructure.

Requirements.REQ-001: EffectTrigger selects own OnActivate, dependency OnUpdate or dependency OnComplete; callbacks run on configured event occurrences, never on Update(deltaTime). At most one callback execution is admitted per Unity frame.
Requirements.REQ-002: A completed callback execution does not terminate observation: after OnComplete the effect remains Active and can execute for later eligible events.
Requirements.REQ-003: Each admitted callback execution emits OnStart, invokes EffectCallback, emits OnUpdate(1f), then OnComplete synchronously. IsUpdating is true only inside the execution cycle, and cleared even when an observer or callback throws; a failing callback does not emit successful OnUpdate.
Requirements.REQ-004: Effect stores strong references to the specified Behavior instances, subscribes when activated and releases event subscriptions on Reset; it never activates, updates or resets its dependencies.
Requirements.REQ-005: Effect observes the supplied Behavior instances, not property slots; replacing a Behavior in a Widget or FVP property does not redirect its dependencies. Effect does not depend on Widget, FVP or property-reference mechanisms.
Requirements.REQ-006: Reentrant triggers during an ongoing execution do not nest an execution cycle. Changing dependencies or triggers while Active replaces the subscribed event set.

Inputs.IN-001: dependencies: Behavior instances — borrowed triggers with strong identity references.
Inputs.IN-002: callback: Action — executed when an eligible trigger is admitted.
Inputs.IN-003: trigger: EffectTrigger flags — OnActivate, OnUpdate, OnComplete.

Outputs.OUT-001: OnStart, OnUpdate(1f), OnComplete — synchronous lifecycle around each admitted execution, not a produced typed value.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Subscribes to configured dependency events and releases them on Reset or live reconfiguration.
SideEffects.EFF-002: Invokes user callback upon an admitted event trigger, at most once per Unity frame.
